response.overview: Kristen Scott’s romantic evening takes an unexpected turn when her boyfriend surprises her with a proposal, while Megan Rain arrives with plans of her own. The two women soon abandon the drama and head inside together.  Roommates Avery Black and Marley Brinx clash when Marley redecorates their room without realizing the sentimental value of Avery’s artwork. Their argument quickly becomes a chaotic confrontation before the pair finds a very different way to settle their differences.  June 2019 Treat of the Month Veronica Rodriguez returns, relaxing poolside in a stunning orange bikini while secretly flirting with beach-club waitress Honey Gold.  Karissa and Kristina Shannon discover the same dress at a sale and compete to claim it, forcing Nikki Delano to step in as judge.  Finally, Scarlett Bloom gets caught snooping around her stepmother Cherie Deville’s office, leading to an awkward confrontation and a memorable lesson in respecting boundaries.
response.title: Wet Dream Girls 9
